purpose: Blind held-out audit of whether a stronger external formalizer can faithfully formalize, without repairing, a deterministic balanced sample of ten natural-language outputs from iter032.

sample.selection_rule: Traverse near-no-think.jsonl in file order and retain the first two IDs encountered for each family.

allowed_inputs.scope_read: Only the ten responses selected by the deterministic rule.
Only the ten public prompt records matching selected IDs.

prohibited_before_seal: prior iter032 near metrics or expected answers
blind_phase.attestation: The judgments were written before reading any prohibited iter032 near material. Claims were extracted only when actually asserted by a selected response, allowing ordinary paraphrase. No incorrect claim was corrected, no missing premise was supplied, and no problem was independently solved around a response.

rubric.faithful_formalization_possible: At least one mathematically meaningful proposition can be represented without changing what the response says; truth is separate.
rubric.certifiable_argument_on_own_precheck: The response states a coherent set of essential claims that can be checked from the public parameters and supports its conclusion without correction, supplied premises, or independent solution.
rubric.requires_repair_or_independent_solving: Certification would require changing a false or contradictory claim, adding an absent essential mathematical step, choosing between contradictory conclusions, or solving the problem independently.
